scope: Obstfeld and Rogoff (1996), Chapter 10: sticky-price models of output, the exchange rate and the current account. The two-country redux model (household optimality with a genuine infinite horizon, steady-state existence and uniqueness for every asset position, the log-linear system as an exact derivative, money shocks, exact no-overshooting, welfare, fiscal and productivity shocks, preset wages), the small open economy with nontradables (exact overshooting iff epsilon > 1, welfare, preset wages, cash-in-advance credibility), and pricing to market and pass-through, with the evidence and the exercises.
source: Maurice Obstfeld and Kenneth Rogoff (1996), Foundations of International Macroeconomics, MIT Press, Chapter 10, pp. 659-713.
